caption: The drawing depicts a lidded vessel with two symmetrical handles, set against a plain brown background. The vessel is predominantly purple, with iridescent highlights in blue, yellow, and white, suggesting a reflective, metallic surface. It has an ornate, rounded body with decorative embossing, and the handles curve outward and upward from each side. The lid is domed and features a small finial at the top. The vessel stands on a broad, short pedestal base, which flares out at the bottom. Text reading “TEA SERVICE” along with some additional notations and a signature is inscribed in white at the lower left and lower right corners of the drawing.
title: Sugar Bowl
